Blurry lights representing radar/pulse abstract background
Abstract dark textured map lines for subtle overlay

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a React Native Expo app.
Ensure all touch targets are at least 48x48px for mobile usability.
Implement bottom tab navigation (Home, Trips, Messages, Profile).
Use high contrast colors for the Validation Code flow to ensure outdoor legibility.
Implement the 'Radar Pulse' animation using React Native Reanimated or similar.
Avoid generic placeholders; use the provided image URLs.
Use testID attributes on all interactive elements for testing.
Style headings with Clash Display (if custom fonts can be loaded) or a bold System font if not, and body with Inter.
Keep border-radius strictly at 12px (rounded-xl) for all cards and buttons to match the Modern Afro-Tech theme.
